notice: Exercise 6 source excerpts, not real retailer policy. Current v1 clauses restate existing retailer-requirements-v1; archive/draft clauses are explicit test-only distractors. This corpus is not added to the original agent's production knowledge.

documents.text: Archived test-only rule: product titles may contain up to 120 characters.
Draft test-only proposal: product titles may contain up to 100 characters. This proposal is not approved policy.
Product titles must contain no more than 80 characters.
Supply exactly five factual bullets. Each bullet must contain no more than 160 characters.
Before submission, the manufacturer must supply a verified product GTIN, approved product images and usage rights, and approved warranty terms.
Cordless drill kits map to Tools > Power Tools > Drills > Drill Kits. Cordless impact driver kits map to Tools > Power Tools > Impact Drivers > Driver Kits.
Use manufacturer facts only. Do not infer certifications, safety performance, runtime, battery chemistry or warranty. MSRP is not the retailer's selling price.
Every package remains needs_review. A human category reviewer and manufacturer fact owner must review before any external submission.
